## Requirements to satisfy and stamp
- **GL-SCHED-01** — cadence-driven `sig-connectors run` per source via a minimal scheduler, respecting
  `PoliteFetcher`/Overpass etiquette; per-source freshness; disappearance-detection cadence.

## Decision (ADR-076)
- **Scheduler form = a minimal GitHub Actions cron** (`.github/workflows/reingest.yml`), **not**
  Prefect/Dagster. The `orchestration/` Dagster seam stays reserved + reversible
  (`ORCHESTRATOR_MODULES` unchanged, SIG-INGEST-021); free-tier under the binding zero-cost posture
  (SIG-STORE-003), reusing the ADR-067 `keepalive.yml` shape.
- **Cadence vs etiquette = two layers** (`orchestration/src/orchestration/cadence.py`): *coarse* = the
  per-source re-ingest interval (`reingest_interval_days`, default 30 days, clamped to
  `MIN_INTERVAL_DAYS = 1`), *fine* = `PoliteFetcher`/`HttpxTransport` request pacing (crawl-delay,
  429/503/504 back-off, Overpass etiquette), never bypassed (non-green source refused exit 3).
- **Freshness** = append-only JSONL `FreshnessLedger`; a changed-upstream re-ingest yields **new dated
  claims** never overwriting prior (P1–P3). **Disappearance** rides the sweep cadence, reusing
  `connectors.disappearance` + `evidence.disappearance.sweep_cadence_days`.

## Acceptance criteria (all deterministic; each test fails if the behaviour is removed)
- [x] a scheduled run re-ingests a source, produces new dated claims (never overwrites) and records
  freshness → `test_scheduled_reingest_produces_new_dated_claims_and_records_freshness`
- [x] a source going dark triggers a disappearance record →
  `test_source_going_dark_triggers_a_disappearance_record` (+ challenge + healthy-none cases)
- [x] append-only preserved (re-ingest adds claims, no UPDATE/DELETE) →
  `test_cadence_module_issues_no_update_or_delete` + `test_freshness_ledger_is_append_only`
- [x] verification green; ADR-076 + `## Revisit trigger`; Appendix F row (SIG-ENG-039); RISK-P24-01 +
  traceability; BUILD_INDEX row 80 + LEDGER advanced; nothing owed to DEFERRALS.
